The '''Nyemarians''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] hailing from the [[planet]] [[Nyemari]].

==Society and culture==
Nyemarians were led by a Duchess, who inhabited the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]]. It was said the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Anem]], the capitol, was the most modern, architectually sophisticated spaceport in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], Nyemarians were fleeing from a global [[civil war]] on [[Nyemari]] and sought refuge at any planet willing to accept them. However, their own sect vowed to kill all deserters.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Under Threat of Death}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Nyemarian's [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was visited by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], on an [[Mission to Nyemari|operation]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They stole the access codes to the [[Nyemari Imperial Military Installation]] from the Duchess' palace. After tripping the silent alarm, the Rebels fled the palace and their pursuers, members of the Royal guard on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]]. The Rebels avoided the guards and returned to the [[South Anem Spaceport]] where they hid their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with the Nyemarian [[Li Preni]]. Preni told them they had been pursued, so the Rebels cornered the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] who followed them. The Glymphid played a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from [[Rezi Soresh]] directing the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to come to Soresh; the Glymphid then [[Death/Legends|died]] from a time-delayed [[Poison/Legends|poison]], and the Rebels left Nyemari.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Nyemarians in the galaxy==
Nyemari had an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] base and a sophisticated spaceport. A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] posing as a Palace guard was not questioned.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nyemarians were introduced in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. The book does not go into detail about their appearance except to suggest they are [[Human/Legends|Humans]] or [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]].
